descriptionHtml:
Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF** processor:


---


**Intel® Core™ i7-14700KF**


**Brand:** Intel

**Model:** i7-14700KF

**Generation:** 14th Gen (Raptor Lake Refresh)

**Code Name:** Raptor Lake


---


**Core Architecture:**

Total Cores: 20

Performance Cores (P-cores): 8

Efficient Cores (E-cores): 12

Total Threads: 28


---


**Clock Speeds:**

P-core Max Turbo Frequency: Up to 5.6 GHz

E-core Max Turbo Frequency: Up to 4.3 GHz

P-core Base Frequency: 3.4 GHz

E-core Base Frequency: 2.5 GHz


---


**Cache:**

Total L3 Cache: 33 MB (Intel Smart Cache)

L2 Cache: 28 MB (combined)


---


**Memory Support:**

Max Memory Size: 192 GB

Memory Types: DDR4-3200, DDR5-5600

Max Memory Channels: 2 (Dual Channel)

Max Memory Bandwidth: 89.6 GB/s

ECC Memory Support: Yes (with supported motherboard)


---


**PCI Express:**

PCI Express Revision: 5.0 and 4.0

Max PCI Express Lanes: 20

- 16 lanes for GPU (PCIe 5.0)

- 4 lanes for SSD (PCIe 4.0)


---


**Processor Graphics:**

Integrated Graphics: No (KF suffix means no integrated GPU)

Requires: Discrete graphics card


---


**Power Specifications:**

Processor Base Power (TDP): 125W

Maximum Turbo Power (MTP): 253W

Minimum Assured Power: 125W


---


**Thermal Specifications:**

Max Junction Temperature (Tjmax): 100°C


---


**Socket Compatibility:**

Socket Type: LGA 1700

Compatible Chipsets: Intel 600 series, 700 series (Z690, Z790, B760, H770, etc.)


---


**Advanced Technologies:**

Intel Turbo Boost Max Technology 3.0: Yes

Intel Hyper-Threading Technology: Yes

Intel Thermal Velocity Boost: Yes

Intel Gaussian & Neural Accelerator (GNA) 3.0: Yes

Intel Deep Learning Boost: Yes

Intel Speed Shift Technology: Yes

Intel Adaptive Boost Technology: Yes


---


**Security Features:**

Intel Virtualization Technology (VT-x): Yes

Intel VT-d: Yes

Intel vPro Eligibility: No

Intel Trusted Execution Technology: No

Intel AES New Instructions: Yes

Secure Key: Yes

OS Guard: Yes

Execute Disable Bit: Yes


---


**Overclocking:**

Unlocked Multiplier: Yes (KF suffix supports overclocking)


---


**Other Features:**

Intel Optane Memory Supported: Yes

Intel Speed Select Technology: No

Thermal Monitoring Technologies: Yes


---


**What's in the Box:**

Processor only

no cooler included - KF processors 


---


**Ideal For:**

High-end gaming

Content creation (video editing, 3D rendering, streaming)

Overclocking enthusiasts

Professional workloads

Multitasking and productivity
